site.name: Erine Palba Febmiani
site.heroTitle: Stories, culture & brands drawn into visual worlds.
site.heroIntro: I’m Erine Palba Febmiani, an illustrator and graphic designer creating expressive visual identities, campaigns, characters, packaging and editorial artwork.

about.title: Erine.
about.lead: A graphic designer and illustrator from Indonesia. Over the past four years, I have actively participated in national competitions and worked on illustration projects for a diverse range of clients.
about.body: My work moves between commercial design and narrative illustration—mascots, cultural storytelling, annual reports, calendars, product packaging and social content. I enjoy research-heavy projects where visual storytelling can make complex ideas feel immediate and memorable.
about.statement: In every stroke of the pen and pixel perfected, lies a story waiting to unfold.

projects.title: Graco Mascot
projects.label: Mascot / Brand Character
projects.description: A friendly coconut character created as part of PT Graha Mitra Lestarindo’s branding. The mascot was designed to support brand recognition across marketing materials, digital platforms and product touchpoints.

projects.title: SIKO
projects.label: Mascot / Character
projects.description: A cheerful character system translated across a presentation board and merchandise mockups.

projects.title: Female Character Illustration
projects.label: Character / Illustration
projects.description: An original female character study showing sketch development, color palette exploration and the final rendered illustration.

projects.title: Chomi Chimi
projects.label: Character / Sticker Series
projects.description: A character branding project featuring a signature duo of charming chinchillas, developed for merchandise and sticker sheets.

projects.title: Graha Mitra Lestarindo Profile
projects.label: Printing / Company Profile
projects.description: Company profile and brochure layouts for a charcoal product brand, balancing product information, brand identity and editorial hierarchy.

projects.title: BNI Calendar 2024
projects.label: Illustration / Calendar
projects.description: An illustrated calendar project combining artistic storytelling with a practical calendar format. The work moves from ideation and sketch development into a colorful final composition.

projects.title: Bank Sultra Calendar 2025
projects.label: Illustration / Culture
projects.description: A calendar illustration exploring Southeast Sulawesi culture, traditional fabrics, local sites, endemic animals and history through research-led visual storytelling.

projects.title: Mandala Finance Calendar 2025
projects.label: Illustration / Campaign
projects.description: The visual concept presents Mandala Finance as a companion across customers’ life journeys, using a lively illustrated world to connect financing services with everyday aspirations.

projects.title: Cheng Ho — The Explorer
projects.label: Award-Winning Illustration
projects.description: First-place illustration in a 2022 competition by the Consulate General of the PRC in Bali. The work tells a historical story of Cheng Ho’s voyages and cultural exchange with the Nusantara.

projects.title: WONDR BNI Annual Report
projects.label: Editorial / Cover Illustration
projects.description: A cover illustration created to visually introduce BNI’s digital-banking transformation and the launch of WONDR BNI with a vibrant, user-centered visual language.

projects.title: From Local to Global — BNI
projects.label: Annual Report / Illustration
projects.description: An editorial illustration that connects local economic activity, digital banking and global ambition through a dense narrative composition.

projects.title: Digitalization to Free the Nation
projects.label: Competition / Telkom Indonesia
projects.description: Favorite winner in a 2022 Telkom Indonesia competition. The illustration explores digital transformation, connectivity and wider access to technology across Indonesia.

projects.title: Tehbotol — Nature & Culture
projects.label: Product / Illustration
projects.description: A product-focused visual concept combining Indonesian biodiversity, cultural traditions and sustainability stories such as Sasi Laut, Dayak Iban forest stewardship and Bali’s Subak irrigation system.

projects.title: Tular Nalar Poster 2023
projects.label: Poster / Competition
projects.description: A poster project about online scams and misinformation, encouraging careful verification and wiser use of social media.

projects.title: Beauty in Pain
projects.label: Apparel / T-Shirt Design
projects.description: Third-place Rekhas Apparel competition entry. The concept contrasts Indonesia’s outward beauty with internal challenges, represented through a heroic figure marked by visible wounds.

projects.title: Nusantara Delights
projects.label: Apparel / T-Shirt Design
projects.description: A second-place Matsuda Apparel design celebrating Indonesian traditional snacks such as pukis, klepon, surabi and bakso in a playful, detailed composition.

projects.title: Hugo — NFT Character
projects.label: Character / NFT
projects.description: Character attribute production for the Anagata NFT project, including body, head, mouth, prosthetic hands, neck and backgrounds with cyberpunk-inspired styling.

projects.title: Perfume Campaign
projects.label: Social Media / Advertising
projects.description: A polished perfume campaign system using warm product photography, floral elements and atmospheric art direction.

projects.title: Charcoal Packaging
projects.label: Packaging / Product
projects.description: Packaging design and structural layout for a charcoal product, combining bold orange branding with clear product features and retail-ready visual hierarchy.

projects.title: Coconut Charcoal Campaign
projects.label: Social Media / Brand Content
projects.description: A visual content series positioning coconut charcoal through product-centered compositions and nature-driven imagery.

projects.title: Social Media Art Direction
projects.label: Social Media / Content System
projects.description: A collection of monthly visual content systems. The work uses product shots, graphic compositions, color, captions and calls-to-action to create consistent brand communication across social channels.
